Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the task by conflating “tallest outside North America” with “world’s tallest overall moving outside North America,” and incorrectly proposed the Petronas Towers (Kuala Lumpur, 1998) as the successor. The correct immediate successor to One Raffles Place (OUB Centre) as the tallest outside North America was the Bank of China Tower in Hong Kong in 1989.
